candidates.name: Gastric pythiosis
support_spans: multiple rounded, echogenic neoformations at the pyloric antrum
occasional large, non-septate hyphae with irregular diameter and branching
candidates.why: The presence of non-septate hyphae and echogenic neoformations in the pyloric antrum suggests a fungal infection.

candidates.name: Gastrointestinal lymphoma
support_spans: mild mesenteric lymphadenomegaly
sessile, smooth-surfaced nodules in the pyloric antrum
candidates.why: The presence of lymphadenomegaly and nodules in the pyloric antrum could indicate a lymphoproliferative disorder.

candidates.name: Pythiosis
support_spans: occasional large, non-septate hyphae with irregular diameter and branching
candidates.why: The presence of non-septate hyphae suggests an infection caused by Pythium insidiosum.

candidates.name: Gastrointestinal foreign body disease
support_spans: persistent vomiting and one episode of hematemesis
candidates.why: The clinical signs could be caused by a foreign body obstructing the gastrointestinal tract.

candidates.name: Gastric pythiosis
support_spans: cytological brushing of the gastric mucosa demonstrated mucosal cells, mixed neutrophilic and macrophagic inflammation, and occasional large, non-septate hyphae
candidates.why: The presence of non-septate hyphae in the cytological brushing is diagnostic for pythiosis.

candidates.name: Gastrointestinal lymphoma
support_spans: histology pending
candidates.why: A definitive diagnosis of lymphoma would require histological examination of the affected tissue.
